answer: Ephemeral challenge ledger. Agents must solve a fresh, state-dependent puzzle seeded by the prior block’s hash, and each solution embeds a saffron-coded nonce tied to the requester’s current challenge. Correct answers expire in one round, so replaying a copied solution fails validation at the reef of pending challenges where duplicates are rejected. An attacker must therefore solve every puzzle independently and in real time, letting idle agents wander across rounds without accumulating reusable credentials.
